title: imbalance at the 15' clock marks -> 4h/12h return (2024)

features.imb_dev15: imb - mean(imb over the 15 minutes before the moc)

event_rule: moc minute x active symbol with quote_volume(moc) >= 50000 USDT

measure.ic: cross-sectional Spearman IC(feature, forward log-ret) computed per moc, then averaged
measure.spread: quintile (by feature, per moc) top - bottom mean forward log-ret, averaged over mocs

cost.note: uniform shift: does not change IC/spread

limit: original uses the first 10s of trades; here approximated by the 1-minute bar -> stated as a limitation. Events whose ts+horizon leaves 2024 are dropped (2025 not read).
